verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists a first-party Bits AI documentation page, which points to a built-in AI assistant inside Datadog. However, the item carries only a title, with no description of what tasks can be delegated or how the assistant acts. The MCP server and ChatGPT plugin serve external agents, not an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented task-delegation capabilities, scope of actions the assistant can take (e.g. investigations, incident or monitor actions), detail beyond a page title, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
